Corpo escuro com a aresta acesa — o volu: Dark body with a lit edge — volume appears through the light running along the border, not the fill. It's the language of the Radar HUD, and the one that survives best at small sizes.
Letreiro físico: azul polido e off-white: Physical sign: polished blue and satin off-white, wide bevel. It's the closest match to what's already live — weight and permanence, without drawing attention to the effect.
O “Fay” vira vidro fumê e o “Ai” fica az: The "Fay" turns into smoked glass and the "Ai" becomes solid blue inside: the accent appears THROUGH the piece. Sophisticated, but the glass only works on dark backgrounds — and it's the most expensive of the three.
